why: I checked the result given for lines 1, 2 and 4. Lines 1 and 2 are PASS, so they don't break the rule. Line 4 ("npm test passes") is marked FAIL, and the reasons are the ones the must_not list bans. The output says a build "that adds padLeft and no test meets this line, so it proves nothing about padLeft". It also says "two readers could also disagree on whether this line requires a padLeft test". It then proposes a stricter missing line that requires a padLeft test covering zero padding, the default fill and long input. The line's words only require the suite to pass, and the request never asks for tests. So this FAIL is based on wording and on a stricter test the words don't need. That is item 1 of the must_not list.
